# 284_R6FIX.21 — external LB :80 → HTTPS redirect (BL-121)

## Summary

- **Defect (BL-121, N-A3-3):** the external LB had no `:80` forwarding rule — `http://` requests to
  the prod hosts got silence, not a redirect.
- **Fix (`infra/pulumi/compute.ts`):** dedicated redirect URLMap (`defaultUrlRedirect` 301 →
  https, `stripQuery: false` so `?next=` deep links survive) + `TargetHttpProxy` + `http-fr`
  forwarding rule on the same `lbAddress` as `https-fr` — the GCP-idiomatic pattern, uniform across
  stages.
- **Deploy-bound:** effective only on the next operator `pulumi up`; Stage A authored program, no
  live claim.
